description: The STAGE Meet video on the new Pik screen: the five live lines (Carl and Steven say them; see STAGE_CUES.md) with holds. Speakers start at 3, 20, 32, 43, 56 s; the screen reacts 7 to 14 s later, at the rows below. Replayed by prototype/live_script.py through live.py's compose/place/emit (the real engine fills tiles, quotes and coverage). Pik's spoken follow-up (vo/stage_followup.wav) is the ask row's text; capture_ui.py checks it still equals engine.ask(L3)['follow_up'].
